title.zh: v2.0.90 自动保存终于看得见：保存中／已保存／保存失败
title.en: v2.0.90 The Auto-Save Is Visible Now: Saving, Saved, or Refused

highlights.zh: **项目每次改动后 500 ms 就被写进 localStorage，而工作台从不告诉用户。** 反倒是「曲风制作器」一直有一个 `● 未保存修改` 徽标。于是用户分不清「已保存」和「只活在内存里」。现在工作台显示**保存中…／已保存／保存失败**三态。
highlights.en: **The project has always been written to localStorage 500 ms after every change, and the studio never said so** — while the genre maker has shown an `● unsaved` badge all along. There was no way to tell a saved project from one living only in memory. The studio now shows **Saving… / Saved / Not saved**.

highlights.zh: **状态由写盘的那个模块拥有。** `projectStorage` 是唯一知道写入是否成功的模块，所以状态归它、界面只订阅——另建一套记账迟早会和事实不一致。「保存中」的含义是「改动还在 debounce 里排队」，不是「字节在飞」，文案就按这个事实写。**`保存失败` 是刻意加的一态**：localStorage 写满或被禁用会抛异常，而旧代码只打了条日志——没有这一态，指示器会在用户的作品**并不安全**时永远显示「保存中…」。
highlights.en: **The status is owned by the module that writes.** `projectStorage` is the only place that knows whether a write succeeded, so it owns the status and the UI only subscribes — parallel bookkeeping would eventually disagree with reality. "Saving" means a change is waiting on the debounce, not that bytes are in flight, and the copy says exactly that. **"Not saved" is a deliberate third state**: localStorage throws when full or disabled and the old code only logged it, so withou…

highlights.zh: **它也说清楚存在哪。** 悬浮提示写「已保存到本浏览器（HH:MM）」与「仅保存在本浏览器——要留副本请导出」：对勾不能暗示云备份，因为并没有云。状态用 `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"`——这份安心对读屏用户同样要有。订阅用 `useSyncExternalStore`（状态在 React 之外变化，debounce 在用户看屏幕时到点），快照对象只在变化时换新。
highlights.en: **It also says where.** The tooltip reads "Saved to this browser at HH:MM" and "Saved in this browser only — export to keep a copy": a checkmark must not imply a cloud backup, because there is no cloud. The state is a `role="status"` live region, because the reassurance matters to a screen reader too. The subscription uses `useSyncExternalStore` (the status changes outside React — the debounce fires while the user is reading the screen) with a snapshot that is only replaced…
